routes._comment: The installed page carries @RoutePage(name: 'MainRoute'), so auto_route generates the route class in the host's own app_router.gr.dart. Path and route name match paas_manager's existing CupertinoRoute(path: '/main', page: MainRoute.page), so host navigation call-sites keep working when the host deletes its own copy of the page.

Sync-issues screen (park-and-surface): parked needs_attention records across the three manager boxes with per-record Retry/Discard. New path, no legacy paas_manager counterpart; route name follows the Manager prefix convention. Reached from the restaurant tab's sections list.

Route names carry a Manager prefix (revenue_sdk's ManagerIncomeRoute convention) but keep paas_manager's exact legacy paths and CupertinoRoute/MaterialRoute types, so host navigation call-sites swap class names only. merchants_sdk's main_page.dart FAB pushes ManagerCreateOrderRoute - that name is this manifest's contract. The installed pages carry @RoutePage(name: 'Manager...Route'), so auto_route generates the classes in the host's own app_router.gr.dart.

The installed page carries @RoutePage() with the NotificationListPage class name, so auto_route generates NotificationListRoute in the host's own app_router.gr.dart. Path and route name match paas_manager's existing hand-written CupertinoRoute(path: '/list-notification', page: NotificationListRoute.page), so the composed restaurant tab's context.pushRoute(const NotificationListRoute()) keeps working when the host deletes its own copy of the page and drops the hand-written route.

boot_hooks._comment: Windows notification delivery, POS parity (1.6.0): firebase_messaging has no Windows implementation, so the FCM hook above deliberately excludes Windows and composed Windows exes shipped with NO notification path at all. This hook starts comms' DesktopNotificationPoller (10s REST count polling + looping POS notification.wav + ValueNotifier badge feed - see the service's doc comment) on Windows only. The start is deferred to addPostFrameCallback because boot-hook bodies run BEFORE LocalStorage.init() and the sdk-di block in the generated main.dart: by first frame both are done, and runApp is never delayed by a poll. Fail-open try/catch like the FCM hook - a boot failure debugPrints instead of blanking the app. WidgetsBinding resolves via main.dart's static material import; foundation dedupes with the FCM hook's wiring import. Toast layer (still 1.6.0, same unmerged PR): poller.start() also initializes LocalNotifications fail-open (flutter_local_notifications 19.x WindowsInitializationSettings - stable hardcoded GUID, APP_NAME/WINDOWS_AUMID dart-defines for branding, works unpackaged; MSIX identity optional host-side) and each count increase raises a native toast via LocalNotifications.show() alongside the sound - no hook body change needed, the toast path lives entirely inside the service.

embedded_widgets._comment: Header slot (ADR-005): shells embed the compact adaptive widget without importing weather_sdk directly. inlineExpansion=false because headers are height-constrained; on small screens that leaves just the minimal icon+temp chip, and the popup-free WeatherInlineForecast card is placed in body flow via the weather_sdk barrel (it takes a WeatherState argument, so it cannot ride the zero-arg embedded-widget seam).
